chunks: Abu Jarir ibn Idris narrated from Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام, who said:
"Perform salat al-layl during travel at the beginning of the night in the carriage, and the Witr, and the two rak'ahs of Fajr."

key_terms.أَوَّلِ اللَّيْلِ: the beginning portion of the night
key_terms.السَّفَرِ: travel; the state of being on a journey
key_terms.الْمَحْمِلِ: the carriage, mount, or riding conveyance
key_terms.الْوَتْرَ: the Witr prayer, the concluding unit of the night prayer
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ: the two rak'ahs associated with Fajr
key_terms.صَلَاةَ اللَّيْلِ: the night prayer performed during the nighttime

ai.seo_question: When should salat al-layl be performed during travel?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction regarding salat al-layl while traveling. It indicates that the night prayer, including al-Witr and the two rak'ahs of Fajr, may be performed from the beginning of the night while in one's mount or carriage.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1381 - Abu Jarir ibn Idris narrated from Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) who said:
"Perform the night prayer (salat al-layl) during travel at the beginning of the night, in the carriage, and also perform the Witr and the two units (rak'ahs) of the Fajr prayer."
